questions_and_answers.question_text: Dōngdān Diànyǐngyuàn shi bu shi zài zhèr fùjìn?

answers.answer_text: Is the Dōngdān Movie Theater in this area?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shì. Zài zhèr fùjìn.

answers.answer_text: Yes. It's in this area.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ zhīdao diànyǐngyuàn fùjìn yǒu meiyou yínháng?

answers.answer_text: Do you know whether there is a bank in the vicinity of the theater?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Yǒu. Diànyǐngyuàn fùjìn yǒu (yíge) yínháng.

answers.answer_text: Yes. There is a bank in the vicinity of the movie theater.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ zhīdao bu zhīdao yínháng shénme shíhou guān mén?

answers.answer_text: Do you know at what time the bank closes?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Cóng zhèr dào nàr qù, zěnme zǒu?

answers.answer_text: How do I get there from here?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Chūle zhèige fàndiàn wàng dōng zǒu.

answers.answer_text: When you have gone out of the hotel, walk to the east.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Dàole dìèrge lùkǒur, běibianr shi Dōngdān Càishìchǎng. Nánbianr shi Dōngdān Gōngyuán.

answers.answer_text: When you have reached the second intersection, on the north side is the Dōngdān Market. On the south side is Dōngdān Park.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Diànyǐngyuàn jiù zài Dōngdān Càishìchǎngde xībianr.

answers.answer_text: The movie theater is just on the west side of the Dōngdān Market.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒ chūle zhèige fàndiàn wàng dōng zǒu, duì bu duì?

answers.answer_text: When I have gone out of the hotel, I walk to the east. Is that correct?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Duì le.

answers.answer_text: That's correct.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Hǎo, běibianr shi Dōngdān Càishìchǎng. Nánbianr ne?

answers.answer_text: Okay, on the north side is the Dōngdān Market. How about on the south side?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nánbianr shi Dōngdān Gōngyuán.

answers.answer_text: On the south side is Dōngdān Park.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Diànyǐngyuàn jiù zài càishìchǎngde xībianr shi bu shi?

answers.answer_text: The movie theater is just on the west side of the market, is that it?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shì.

answers.answer_text: Yes.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Qù kàn diànyǐng yǐqián wǒ xiān qù kàn yíge péngyou.

answers.answer_text: Before I go to see the movie, I am first going to visit a friend.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Fàndiàn lǐbianr yǒu meiyou mài tángde?

answers.answer_text: Is there a place to buy candy in the hotel?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Yǒu. Yǒu yíge xiǎomàibù. Zài nèibianr.

answers.answer_text: Yes. There's a variety shop. It's over there.
